name: Desktop
description:
# Summary

This task involved integrating the views store with the Desktop component to manage project-specific layouts. The Desktop component now automatically loads a project's last saved view when switching projects, and auto-saves layout changes to the views store with a 1-second debounce. The views store was enhanced to support project-scoped operations, tracking the `last_update` timestamp to identify the most recent view for each project. Three files were modified: `src/store/views.js` (added project filtering and auto-save logic), `src/components/desktop/Desktop.vue` (added project watcher and layout auto-save), and the existing `src/api/modules/views.js` required no changes as it already supported the necessary API operations.

messages.content:
Update Desktop to user the new views store to load the project's last view.
Use views store to save vew when it changes, saving view will update the last_update field.
If the active project changes (global $project) use views to load the vies associated with the project.
views store will return the lastes view for a project or create a new one
